scale.impact: 1 negligible - 5 severe (athlete harm, legal exposure, or product cannot run)
scale.score: likelihood x impact; 15+ red, 8-14 amber, <8 green

rule: A mitigation counts only if controlEvidence points to a test, CI gate, code path or decision record in this repo. A risk with no controlEvidence is scored as unmitigated.

risks.risk: Server data layer cannot work in production: Firestore client SDK without credentials against owner-only rules
risks.trigger: Any server read returns permission-denied in staging
risks.mitigation: Adapter onto firebase-admin with verified uid; emulator tests for the 12 Dirty Dozen payloads
risks.costIfHit: Pilot cannot start; no athlete data persists

risks.risk: Collecting physical-condition data in the UAE without a DPIA
risks.trigger: Pilot date set before DPIA sign-off
risks.mitigation: DPIA under UAE PDPL before any athlete data; legal review of the health-data carve-out and free-zone regimes

risks.risk: A pain or illness signal written in free text is missed
risks.trigger: Coach audit finds a free-text complaint with no escalation
risks.mitigation: Explicit pain flag always escalates (tested); free-text classifier with a labelled set before scale
risks.costIfHit: Athlete harm; loss of club trust

risks.risk: Bus factor of 1: a solo builder is the only person who can run, fix or explain the system
risks.trigger: Founder unavailable for > 1 week during the pilot
risks.mitigation: Decision log, runbook-grade docs, CI gates that encode the rules; named backup coach per pilot club

risks.risk: Clubs will not pay a price above coach-software anchors ($1.50-2.74 per athlete-month)
risks.trigger: Fewer than 2 of 5 club owners sign a pilot LOI at the modelled price
risks.mitigation: Sell coach capacity (athletes per coach) and time saved, not software; test price in LOIs
risks.costIfHit: No business at the modelled price

risks.risk: Escalations exceed coach capacity in rigid-schedule rosters
risks.trigger: Coach review minutes per athlete-month above the model's standard-segment value for 2 weeks
risks.mitigation: Capture schedule flexibility at onboarding; recruit flexible athletes first; show coaches the segment mix
risks.costIfHit: Coach burnout; club sees services, not software

risks.risk: Model proposals are poor, so rules block many of them and the coach queue floods
risks.trigger: bounds_rejected / adaptation_proposed above 30% for a week
risks.mitigation: Rejection rate is a modelled driver and a telemetry event; engine plan stands whenever a proposal is blocked

risks.risk: A funded competitor ships hybrid scheduling (running apps adding strength, or coach platforms adding AI)
risks.trigger: A top-5 app announces concurrent-training scheduling
risks.mitigation: Moat is coach-signed protocols plus escalation-outcome data, not the scheduler; publish the rules and evidence openly
risks.costIfHit: Wedge narrows to the coach-in-the-loop B2B2C position

risks.risk: Literature-default rules are wrong for a specific athlete
risks.trigger: Coach overrides the same rule on the same athlete 3 times
risks.mitigation: Coach attention on H4 and H6; override logging; coach sign-off on parameters

risks.risk: Pinned model is retired or repriced
risks.trigger: Provider deprecation notice for the pinned model
risks.mitigation: Engine prescribes without the model (ADR-004); add a model-availability check to CI

risks.risk: A contraindicated exercise reaches an injured athlete
risks.trigger: Any contraindication leak in CI or a coach report
risks.mitigation: Engine filter + bounds checker + hand-labelled eval set, all in CI

risks.trigger: A model output reaches the athlete without passing prescribe()/prescribeHybrid()
risks.mitigation: Model output is a proposal; only the checkers can route it; injected text fails B9/H9

risks.risk: Marketing claims injury prevention the evidence does not support
risks.trigger: Any copy that says a rule prevents injury
risks.mitigation: ADR-007 lists claims we refuse; rules labelled as coach-attention limits

risks.trigger: Any request authenticated by something other than a verified ID token in production
risks.mitigation: Verified Firebase ID tokens; x-user-id refused in production; boot check in CI

risks.risk: HYROX growth (the why-now) stalls; the numbers are company-reported
risks.trigger: Season participation flat year over year
risks.mitigation: Segment is hybrid athletes, not HYROX only; market figures graded B/C and not used as headline
